description: Comprehensive migration guide and mapping table from Legacy Xposed (XposedBridge / EdXposed / LSPosed legacy API) to modern LibXposed

mappings.notes: In LibXposed, extend XposedModule and override onPackageReady. Use param.getClassLoader() and param.getPackageName().
Locate the Method using reflection (or Reflector.findMethod), then call hook(method).intercept(chain -> ...).
Execute your logic before chain.proceed(). If you want to skip the original method and return a value, simply return that value without calling chain.proceed().

mappings.modern: Code after Object result = chain.proceed() in Hooker.intercept(chain)
mappings.notes: Execute chain.proceed() first, capture the result, inspect or alter it, and return the final value.
Do not call chain.proceed(). Return the replacement value directly from intercept().
Do not call chain.proceed(). Throw the exception directly from intercept().
Returns the instance receiver, or null for static methods.
chain.getArgs() returns an unmodifiable List<Object>. To modify arguments for downstream execution, call chain.proceed(newArgs).
The result is the direct return value of chain.proceed().
Invokers bypass Java access checks and directly invoke the original implementation without re-triggering hooks.
Replaces the deprecated and broken world-readable file approach with secure framework IPC.
Place the fully qualified class name in META-INF/xposed/java_init.list and add the required ProGuard keep rules.
